def test_invalid_mode():

def test_valid_modes():

    assert result["mode"] == "all"

    """Worker defaults missing legacy mode to all"""
    jobs = [
        {"id": 1, "mode": "remote"},
        {"id": 2, "mode": "hybrid"},
        {"id": 3, "mode": "office"},
    ]
    task = {}  # No mode, defaults to all
    result = worker.execute(task, jobs)
    assert len(result) == 3  # All jobs included

    jobs = [

    jobs = [
